effect_description_eng:
＜Evade＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted, you may suspend it to prevent that deletion.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] 1 of your Digimon may unsuspend. Then, 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers can't unsuspend until their turn ends.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] You may play 1 4000 DP or lower Digimon card with the [Iliad] trait or [Beast], [Animal] or [Sovereign] in any of its traits (other than [Sea Animal]), from your hand without paying the cost.
xros_req: [Digivolve] Lv.4 w/[Garurumon] in name or w/[TS] trait: Cost 3
